content: Basli7eelenne Elyaabe
Qasseka GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Beya; tani Yuhuda zereth gidida Uures naaza naa, Huurey naa, Basli7eele dooradis.
Iza tani ta Ayanan; hiillateththan, akeekaninne ooso ubbaa ooththiza erateththan kunththadis.
Hessika izi qoppi qoppidi hiillateththan, worqqafe, birappenne xarqimalappe dumma dumma miish ooththanaassa.
Hessaththoka al7o shuch massi massidi giigsanaas, mith massanaassinne heytantta ubbaa ooththanaassa.
«Hessa bollaka qasse iza maaddana mala, Daane zereth gidida Ahisaameke naa Eelaabe dooradis. Tani nena azazidayssa ubbaa istti ooththana mala, kushe hiillateth erizayta ubbaas erateth immadis.
Istti ooththanayssi Xoossa Dunkaane, Caaqo qaalay izan diza Taabotaanne Taabotaza bolla woththiza atoteththa kama, Xoossa Dunkaaneza ooththanaas go7ettiza miishshata ubbaa,
xaraphpheezanne iza miishshata, walakay baynda worqqafe oosettida xomppe iza bolla woththiza miish ubbaara, exaane cuwasi yarshizasoza,
xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasozanne iza miishshata ubbaara, meecettiza kerenne keraa iza bolla woththiza miishshara,
dadetti oosettida carqqata, qeese Aarooney may7iza dumma may7o, iza attuma nayti qeeseteththa ooso ooththishe may7ana may7o,
qasse tiyettiza zaytenne geeshsha sozas sawo tunnu giza exaane. Istti hayssa ubbaa tani nena azazida mala ooththana» gides.
Sambata
Hessafe guye GODAY Muse,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Ta Sambataa lo7eththi naagite. Hessi tani GODAY inttena taas dumma histtada dooridayssa bessizaaz gididi yaana yeleta ubbaas taappenne inttefe giddon malata gidana.
Inttes he gallassay dumma gidida gishshas Sambata naagite. Iza tunisiza asi mule hayqqanaas bessees; he gallassan ooso ooththizay oonikka ba asaa garsafe dhayo.
Usuppun gallassatan intte ooso ooththite; gido attiin laappunththa gallassay taas GODAAS dummatida shempo Sambata; he gallassaan ooththizaadey oonikka mulera hayqqanaas bessees.
Isra7eele asay he Sambata gallassaa naa naas mernaas malata histtidi naago.
Tani usuppun gallassatan salonne sa7a medhdhada laappunththa gallassan ooso aggada shempida gishshas, taassinne Isra7eele naytas giddon hayssi mernaas caaqo gidana› ga» gides.
GODAY Musera Siina zumaa bolla haasayzayssa wursida mala izi ba biradhdhen xaafida tammu azazota oykkida nam7u masettida shuchchata Muses immides.
